draft_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline significantly outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
rationale: The claim uses "significantly" for the Tessaline vs Varrow-NMT comparison, but the only reported statistical test (S1) is for Tessaline vs PhraseGrid. No test is reported for the Tessaline vs Varrow-NMT comparison, so significance is unsupported. The means (28.4 vs 27.6) are correct.
